test.query: SELECT count() FROM numbers(1000000) WHERE NOT ignore( concat('{"a', toString(number % 100), '":[{"k":', toString(number), '}],"b', toString(number % 50), '":["x"],"c":[1,2],"d":{"e":[1.5]}}')::JSON(max_dynamic_paths=2))

SELECT count() FROM numbers(1000000) WHERE NOT ignore( concat('{"p', toString(number % 200), '":', multiIf(number % 4 = 0, '"s"', number % 4 = 1, '1', number % 4 = 2, '1.5', '[1]'), '}')::JSON(max_dynamic_paths=256))
